description: MetricsDashboard component contract schema — published as data-* attributes in the DOM

attributes.data-empty: Boolean — true if result set is empty, else absent
attributes.data-loading: Boolean — true while fetching data, else absent

metrics.name: total
metrics.description: Total count of reports in range

metrics.name: status-breakdown
metrics.description: Count by status: approved, pending, rejected

metrics.name: avg-review-time
metrics.description: Average days from creation to approval

metrics.name: daily-trend
metrics.description: Reports per day for last 14 days (for charting)

export.description: Export button must be always available (clickable even with 0 rows → empty CSV)
